title: SAV Prediction Models
text: SAVM package includes multiple pre-trained models predicting submerged aquatic vegetation (SAV) presence/absence percent cover. vignette provides details available models demonstrates load use directly sav_load_model() function. users, high-level sav_model() function (documented “Get started SAVM” vignette) sufficient. However, advanced users may want access underlying models directly custom predictions, model inspection, integration workflows. current models last updated October 10, 2025.

title: SAV Prediction Models
text: package includes three types models, predicting either presence/absence (pa) percent cover (cover): Random Forest (RF) - Default models flexible predictor selection Generalized Additive Models (GAM) - Captures non-linear relationships Linear Mixed Models (LMM) - Accounts hierarchical structure

title: SAV Prediction Models
text: Cover Model (rf_cover) Type: Regression Trees: 250 Variables tried split: 1 Training size: 435 observations Variance explained: ~41.4% (OOB estimate) Response: Percent cover (0-100) Presence/Absence Model (rf_pa) Type: Classification Predictors: Depth (m) Fetch (km) Response: Binary (0 = absent, 1 = present)

title: SAV Prediction Models
text: GAMs use smooth terms capture non-linear relationships. models require depth fetch. Cover Model (gam_cover) Family: Gaussian identity link Formula: Cover ~ s(Depth) + s(Fetch) Smooths: Thin plate regression splines Training size: 36,193 observations Deviance explained: ~17.5% Presence/Absence Model (gam_pa) Family: Binomial logit link Formula: Presence ~ s(Depth) + s(Fetch) Smooths: Thin plate regression splines Output: Probability presence

title: SAV Prediction Models
text: LMMs incorporate random effects Project Year, accounting hierarchical structure data. models require depth fetch. Cover Model (lmm_cover) Formula: Cover ~ Depth * Fetch + (Depth^2) + (Fetch^2) + (1 | Project) + (1 | Year) Fixed effects: Linear quadratic terms Depth Fetch, plus interaction Random effects: Random intercepts Project (6 levels) Year (5 levels) Training size: 36,193 observations Residual SD: ~28.4 Presence/Absence Model (lmm_pa) Family: Binomial logit link Formula: Presence ~ Depth * Fetch + (Depth^2) + (Fetch^2) + (1 | Project) + (1 | Year) Random effects: Random intercepts Project Year

title: Compute wind fetch and wind weighted fetch — compute_fetch
text: points sf Points representing locations fetch calculated. polygon sf Polygon defining land boundaries used compute fetch distances. max_dist numeric Maximum fetch distance kilometers. Fetch beyond distance capped. n_bearings integer Total number bearings fetch calculation (minimal number required 4, default 16). Ignored wind_weights provided. wind_weights data.frame data frame specifying directional weights wind exposure. Must contain two columns: direction (numeric, degrees) weight (numeric). Note weighting applies points. crs object Coordinate reference system (CRS) passed sf::st_crs(), used transform points polygon. land_polygon logical Indicates whether polygon represents land (TRUE) water (FALSE). TRUE, points inside polygon considered outsiders (inland points). FALSE, points outside polygon considered outsiders. Default FALSE.

title: Compute wind fetch and wind weighted fetch — compute_fetch
text: list two elements: mean_fetch: sf object 4 columns: id_point: point identifier outsider: logical indicating point outsider fetch_km: mean wind fetch based bearings (NA outsiders) weighted_fetch_km: mean weighted wind fetch based bearings (NA outsiders) transect_lines: sf object containing radial transects columns points following additional columns (NULL points outsiders): id_point: point identifier direction: direction (degrees) cardinal_direction: cardinal direction (e.g., N, NE, E, etc.) weight: wind weight transect_length: transect length meters computed using sf::st_length() rank: transect ranks (lower rank, longer transect)

title: Apply SAV prediction models — sav_model
text: dat data.frame|sf data.frame sf object containing depth fetch data (required), optionally secchi, substrate, limitation columns post-hoc adjustments. Additional columns ignored. method_pa character Statistical method presence/absence model. One "rf" (Random Forest), "gam" (Generalized Additive Model), "lmm" (Linear Mixed Model). Default "rf". method_cover character Statistical method cover model. One "rf" (Random Forest), "gam" (Generalized Additive Model), "lmm" (Linear Mixed Model). Default method_pa. pa_threshold numeric Probability threshold (0-1) converting presence/absence predictions binary values. Values threshold classified absent (0), values present (1). Default 0.5. depth character (required) Name column containing depth data (meters). Default "depth". fetch character (required) Name column containing fetch data (kilometers). Default "fetch". substrate character (optional) Name column containing substrate limitation data (optional). Binary indicator (0 = limitation, 1 = limited) substrate constraints. Default "substrate". Set NULL disable substrate-based post-hoc adjustments. secchi character (optional) Name column containing Secchi depth data meters (optional). Used calculate maximum colonization depth (Vmax) via Chambers Kalff equation. Default "secchi". Set NULL disable Vmax calculations. limitation character (optional) Name column containing user-supplied limitation data (optional). Binary indicator (0 = limitation, 1 = limited) additional constraints. Default "limitation". Set NULL disable user-supplied limitation adjustments. vmax_par named list (required secchi) Named list intercept slope parameters Chambers Kalff (1985) equation compute maximum depth plant colonization (Vmax). Default list(intercept = 1.40, slope = 1.33) (Model : Quebec + international lakes). See Details Model B parameters.

title: Apply SAV prediction models — sav_model
text: data frame (sf object) containing input columns along model predictions. Column names standardized depth_m fetch_km. following prediction columns always returned: pa_prob: Raw presence/absence probability predictions (0-1). pa_pred: Binary presence/absence classification based pa_threshold. cover_pred: Raw cover predictions (percent, 0-100). pa_post_hoc: Presence/absence post-hoc treatment (0 limitation). cover_post_hoc: Cover post-hoc treatment (0 limitation). Secchi depth data provided, two additional columns returned: vmax: Maximum colonization depth calculated via Chambers & Kalff equation. limitation_secchi: Logical indicating light limitation (TRUE depth exceeds vmax).

title: Apply SAV prediction models — sav_model
text: function applies two types models: one predicting presence/absence SAV another predicting SAV cover. Three statistical methods available: Random Forest ("rf"): Non-parametric ensemble method, robust non-linear relationships. Best complex patterns. Generalized Additive Models ("gam"): Semi-parametric method smooth functions. Good balance interpretability flexibility. Linear Mixed Models ("lmm"): Parametric approach accounting hierarchical data structure. Useful grouped data. can specify different methods presence/absence cover predictions using method_pa method_cover parameters. details models, see Croft-White et al. (2022).

title: Apply SAV prediction models — sav_model
text: Required predictors (depth fetch): depth fetch data mandatory. default, function looks columns named "depth" "fetch". columns found, function attempt auto-detect columns using case-insensitive matching 'depth_m', 'depth', 'fetch_km', 'fetch'. columns found, error thrown. use custom column names, explicitly specify via depth fetch parameters. Optional predictors (substrate, secchi, limitation): columns optional post-hoc adjustments. default, function looks columns exact names. column found data, post-hoc adjustment skipped. use custom column names, explicitly specify via respective parameters. explicitly disable post-hoc adjustment even column exists, set parameter NULL.

title: Apply SAV prediction models — sav_model
text: Post-hoc adjustments refine raw predictions setting 0 wherever limitations detected: substrate: Substrate limitation (e.g., unsuitable bottom substrate). limitation: User-supplied limitation data. limitation_secchi: Light limitation calculated Secchi depth. columns treated binary indicators: value > 0 indicates limiting condition. limitations present, pa_post_hoc cover_post_hoc set 0.

title: Apply SAV prediction models — sav_model
text: Secchi depth data provided, maximum colonization depth (Vmax) calculated using Chambers Kalff (1985) equation. vmax_par parameter controls regression coefficients: Model (default): list(intercept = 1.40, slope = 1.33) - Quebec + international lakes Model B: list(intercept = 1.32, slope = 1.14) - Quebec lakes Sites depth exceeds Vmax flagged light-limited via limitation_secchi column.

title: Apply SAV prediction models — sav_model
code: # \donttest{ # Basic usage with auto-detection of column names sav_model(data.frame(depth = c(5, 10), fetch = c(1, 2))) #> ! No column available for post-hoc treatment. #>   depth_m fetch_km pa_prob pa_pred cover_pred pa_post_hoc cover_post_hoc #> 1       5        1   0.984       1   88.38661           1       88.38661 #> 2      10        2   0.000       0    0.00000           0        0.00000  # Using different methods for PA and cover sav_model(   data.frame(depth_m = c(5, 10), fetch_km = c(1, 2)),   method_pa = "rf",   method_cover = "gam" ) #> ! No column available for post-hoc treatment. #>   depth_m fetch_km pa_prob pa_pred cover_pred pa_post_hoc cover_post_hoc #> 1       5        1   0.984       1        100           1            100 #> 2      10        2   0.000       0          0           0              0  # Adjusting PA threshold sav_model(   data.frame(depth = c(5, 10), fetch = c(1, 2)),   pa_threshold = 0.7 # More conservative predictions ) #> ! No column available for post-hoc treatment. #>   depth_m fetch_km pa_prob pa_pred cover_pred pa_post_hoc cover_post_hoc #> 1       5        1   0.984       1   88.38661           1       88.38661 #> 2      10        2   0.000       0    0.00000           0        0.00000  # Using post-hoc treatment with Secchi and substrate data sav_model(   dat = data.frame(     depth = c(5, 10, 5),     fetch = c(1, 2, 10),     secchi = c(1, 10, 10),     substrate = c(1, 1, 0)   ) ) #> ℹ Using substrate and secchi for post-hoc treatment. #>   depth_m fetch_km substrate secchi limitation_secchi     vmax pa_prob pa_pred #> 1       5        1      TRUE      1              TRUE  1.96000   0.984       1 #> 2      10        2      TRUE     10             FALSE 19.91335   0.000       0 #> 3       5       10     FALSE     10             FALSE 19.91335   0.000       0 #>   cover_pred pa_post_hoc cover_post_hoc #> 1   88.38661           0              0 #> 2    0.00000           0              0 #> 3    0.00000           0              0  # Using custom column names sav_model(   dat = data.frame(     water_depth = c(5, 10),     wave_fetch = c(1, 2)   ),   depth = "water_depth",   fetch = "wave_fetch" ) #> ! No column available for post-hoc treatment. #>   depth_m fetch_km pa_prob pa_pred cover_pred pa_post_hoc cover_post_hoc #> 1       5        1   0.984       1   88.38661           1       88.38661 #> 2      10        2   0.000       0    0.00000           0        0.00000  # Disabling post-hoc adjustments by setting to NULL sav_model(   dat = data.frame(     depth = c(5, 10),     fetch = c(1, 2),     substrate = c(1, 0) # substrate column exists but will be ignored   ),   substrate = NULL # explicitly disable substrate adjustments ) #> ! No column available for post-hoc treatment. #>   depth_m fetch_km pa_prob pa_pred cover_pred pa_post_hoc cover_post_hoc #> 1       5        1   0.984       1   88.38661           1       88.38661 #> 2      10        2   0.000       0    0.00000           0        0.00000  # Using Model B Vmax parameters (Quebec lakes only) sav_model(   dat = data.frame(depth = c(5, 10), fetch = c(1, 2), secchi = c(2, 3)),   vmax_par = list(intercept = 1.32, slope = 1.14) ) #> ℹ Using secchi for post-hoc treatment. #>   depth_m fetch_km secchi limitation_secchi     vmax pa_prob pa_pred cover_pred #> 1       5        1      2              TRUE 4.452892   0.984       1   88.38661 #> 2      10        2      3              TRUE 6.617334   0.000       0    0.00000 #>   pa_post_hoc cover_post_hoc #> 1           0              0 #> 2           0              0 # }

title: SAVM 0.1.0
text: Fix problematic conversion one-column matrix. Lint code. CI update + manifest update.

title: SAVM 0.0.2
text: New shiny app exposes package capacities. compute_fetch() gains argument land_polygon work land polygons. Bearings oriented properly element transect_lines object returned compute_fetch() gains column cardinal_direction (see #15). Argument remove_outsiders removed compute_fetch(), instead column outsider identifies outsiders added. identify_outsiders() renamed visualize_outsiders(). sav_load_model() now exposed vignette “SAV Prediction Models” details model available. models using fetch depth supported, therefore argument type dropped sav_model(). New glmm gam models available.

title: SAVM 0.0.1
text: compute_fetch() new argument remove_outsider remove points falling outside polygon. Also, identify_outsiders() helps visualize outsiders (see #13). Model plot functions adjusted handle sf objects (see #11). element mean_fetch returned compute_fetch() now sf object (see #9). preview_grid() allows preview grid (see #8). Add guidance reading shapefiles vignette (see #6). invert_polygon() added invert polygon (see #6). compute_fetch() new argument n_bearings provides number bearings, replaces n_quad_seg (see #4 #5). compute_fetch() compute mean fetch bearings, columns suffix _all therefore removed (see #4).
